subtitle: 줄파락 술트라제 완성 직전 칼파탈 닌자 참사

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
줄파락에서 상트라제만 있었는데
드디어 장트라제까지 떴다!
이제 합치면 에픽 술트라제라고!
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly low-angle 3/4 view in agile Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy Zul'Farrak stone floor touch. On the left, 언데드 성기사 (weapons and shield neatly sheathed on her back) leans forward with sparkling excited eyes and raised fists, cheering at a glowing compact one-handed sword (Jang'thraze) resting atop a small carved troll stone pedestal in the center. On the right, 스카이본 마법사 (staff sheathed on her back) claps lightly with a calm, mildly amused smile.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
어... 도적님? 잠깐만요!
그거 합치면 양손검인데
왜 장트라제에 입찰을?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic wide shot in agile Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the right, tiny 노움 도적 (her green daggers securely sheathed at her waist) leaps gleefully, tossing a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube die showing ONLY classic round dot pips (strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters) with one hand while snatching the compact one-handed sword Jang'thraze with the other. On the left, 언데드 성기사 (weapons and shield sheathed on her back) freezes mid-step, reaching out in wide-eyed disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
20골이요? 에이, 저도 이거
보고 온 거라 양보 못 해요!
그럼 수고요~ 칼파탈!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder angle from behind 언데드 성기사 on the left toward 노움 도적 on the right, pure solid white #FFFFFF background. 언데드 성기사 (weapons and shield sheathed on her back) desperately holds out a small tied brown leather pouch overflowing with shiny round gold coins in both hands. Across from her, 노움 도적 (daggers sheathed at waist) smugly hugs the compact one-handed sword Jang'thraze under one arm, flashing a cheeky peace sign as a swirling Vanish smoke puff cloud erupts around her feet.

Close two-shot freeze-frame reaction cut on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background with subtle vertical comic gloom lines. On the left, 언데드 성기사 (weapons sheathed on back) stands completely rigid with hollow blank white eyes and a tiny comical ghost soul drifting out of her open mouth, still clutching the rejected leather gold pouch. On the right, 스카이본 마법사 stares silently with wide deadpan eyes at the lingering puff of empty Vanish smoke where the rogue stood.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
도적이 저걸 왜 먹겠어.
기사님이 너무 신나하니까
일부러 입찰 굴린 거지.
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot looking down slightly on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon floor shadow. On the left, 스카이본 마법사 (staff sheathed on back) stands with arms crossed and a cold deadpan side-eye. On the right, 언데드 성기사 (weapons sheathed on back) sits slumped cross-legged on the floor with her shoulders drooping in utter defeat.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
내 임프보다 더한 악마네...
다들 기억해. 인던에서 템 뜨면
절대 좋아하지 마라!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-view comedy finale shot on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, 인간 흑마법사 (tucking her grumpy little red imp plush doll snugly under her left arm) points a stern cautionary index finger straight toward the viewer with a dead-serious expression. On the right, 언데드 성기사 lies completely face-down on the floor in silent despair beside her unspent leather coin pouch. Floating solemnly beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers nods gravely with tiny stubby arms crossed.
